'''Shamkir Football Club''' ({{langx|az|Şəmkir Futbol Klubu}}) was an [[Azerbaijan]]i [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Şəmkir]], that currently plays in the [[Azerbaijan First Division]]. The club is one of the oldest and most successful clubs in Azerbaijan's football history with two [[Azerbaijan Premier League]] titles."}}
